facts.business: Satin Creditcare Network Limited is a loan provider operating as a non-banking financial company.
key_risks: Geopolitical developments remain a significant source of uncertainty
Escalating tensions in the Middle East involving Iran, Israel, and the United States have heightened concerns around energy security and global trade
Prolonged Russia–Ukraine conflict continues to affect energy markets and commodity supply chains
Strategic competition between the United States and China, manifested through tariffs, technology restrictions, and competition for critical minerals
facts.related_party_note: None of the Directors/Key Managerial Personnel and/or their relatives are in any way concerned or interested, financially or otherwise in this resolution except to the extent of their shareholding in the Company.
